# 外部独立数学 oracle：Robin 导热离散与屏障误差界

本文件由外部独立复核代理在 Moonshine 第 1 阶段运行期间推导，未读取其尚未生成的程序。它不是 Moonshine 自主发现，也不是新的通用误差定理。可作为明确标注来源的后续输入，让 Moonshine 复核、实现并检验适用性。对应代码 `oracle_checks.py` 的真实结果为 `oracle_results.json`。

## 1. 方格单元中心有限体积离散

单位正方形，n×n 网格，Δ=1/n，k>0。T 是相对于固定环境温度的温升，x_i=(i+1/2)Δ、y_j=(j+1/2)Δ。离散方程采用“每个单元的热量平衡”，不除以单元面积。

内部面长度 Δ、两中心距离 Δ，因此导热系数为 k。Robin 边界面中心至单元中心距离 Δ/2。沿法向消去边界面温度 T_f：

    outward integrated flux = k Δ (T_cell − T_f)/(Δ/2) = h_s Δ T_f,
    β_s = Δ/(Δ/(2k)+1/h_s) = kΔ/(k/h_s+Δ/2),
    outward integrated flux = β_s T_cell.

每个边界面向本单元的对角线加 β_s。角单元累加两面；n=1 时唯一单元累加四面，不能只计两面。右端 b_i=∫cell q dA。若用中心值近似源积分，必须声明这是一种有网格依赖的近似；对题面的两个矩形热源，用矩形与单元相交面积积分可使总发热量固定为 0.12。

对于中心采样的原矩形源，n=24 时总发热量为 75/576≈0.1302083333，与 0.12 不同；这本身不等于程序错误，但比较不同网格时不能忽视源离散的变化。

## 2. SPD、单调性和守恒

对任意实向量 v，

    vᵀAv = k Σ内部无向边(i,j) (v_i−v_j)² + Σ边界面(i,s) β_s v_i².

所有项非负。若和为零，连通网格使 v 恒定；至少一个 β_s>0 又使常数为零，因此 A 对称正定。题面所有 h_s≥0.2 自动满足条件。

A 的非对角元非正且连通。若 Av≥0 但 v 有负最小值，最小点的所有差 v_i−v_j≤0，边界项 β_s v_i≤0；该行必须全为等号。沿邻接边传播到有正边界系数的点便矛盾。因此 Av≥0⇒v≥0，A⁻¹逐项非负（离散最大值原理）。

将各单元方程相加，内部边通量相消，得到 Σ边界 β_s T_i = Σ_i b_i。这是守恒校验。b≥0 时最大值原理给出 T≥0。

## 3. 不需要特征值计算的解析屏障

假设 h_s≥h_min>0，定义 f(t)=t(1−t)，

    F_ij = k/h_min + f(x_i)+f(y_j),
    z_ij = F_ij / (4kΔ²).

则对本节精确定义的离散矩阵，逐项有 Az≥1，且 z>0。

证明细节如下：

1. 在完整五点模板中，二次函数 f 的中心二阶差分精确，故 kΣ四邻居(F_ij−F_neighbor)=4kΔ²。
2. 每个缺失的边界外邻居在上述完整模板中贡献恰为 kΔ。例如左面 x=Δ/2 时 f(Δ/2)−f(−Δ/2)=Δ；右面同理。若本单元有 m 个边界面，保留内部邻居后的图 Laplacian 作用为 4kΔ²−m kΔ。
3. 网格中心满足 f(x_i),f(y_j)≥f(Δ/2)=Δ/2−Δ²/4。因此

       F_ij ≥ k/h_min+Δ−Δ²/2
            ≥ k/h_min+Δ/2
            ≥ k/h_s+Δ/2,

   其中第二步使用 0<Δ≤1，第三步使用 h_s≥h_min。
4. 每个边界面由 β_s F_ij≥kΔ 补回被移除的贡献。所以

       (AF)_ij = 4kΔ²−m kΔ + Σ边界面 β_s F_ij ≥4kΔ²,

   除以 4kΔ² 即得 Az≥1。
5. n=1 时 Δ=1，m=4。唯一单元没有内部邻居，4kΔ²−m kΔ=0；F=k/h_min+1/2，四个 β_s F 各自≥k，故论证仍成立。角单元 m=2、一般边单元 m=1、内部单元 m=0 均已包括。

设 T 为离散系统 AT=b 的精确解，近似解为 T̃，残差 r=b−AT̃，c=||r||∞。因为 A(cz±(T−T̃))≥c1−|r|≥0，由单调性可得

    |T−T̃| ≤ c z  （逐项），
    ||T−T̃||∞ ≤ ||r||∞ max_i z_i,
    |max_i T_i − max_i T̃_i| ≤ ||T−T̃||∞.

这是对离散场和离散热点“温度数值”的界，不是热点位置界，也不是连续 PDE 与真实芯片温度的误差界。n=24、k=1、h_min=0.2 时 max z≈791.875，可能较保守；不能预先保证它比原始残差阈值在总成本上更好。

残差计算需要组装或施加 A，必须计入在线成本；解析 z 可预计算，不需要额外完整求解。若系统统一除以 Δ²，需要同步缩放残差和屏障，不能混用两种归一化。

## 4. 一次离线求解的缓存屏障

令 A_min=A(h_min,h_min,h_min,h_min)，精确求解 A_min w=1。由单调性 w>0。β(h) 对 h 单调增加，因此 A(μ)=A_min+D(μ)，D 是非负对角矩阵，A(μ)w≥1。于是也有 |T−T̃|≤||r||∞w。

这通常可能比解析 z 更紧，但需要计入一次离线完整求解、储存和验证 w 的成本。使用浮点近似 w̃ 时，未经验证不可直接称为认证屏障。

如果已可靠证明 δ=||1−A_min w̃||∞<1，则 A_min w̃≥(1−δ)1>0，使 w̃>0；w̃/(1−δ) 成为有效的全参数屏障。参见 Minamihata、Sekine、Ogita、Oishi (2013), Reliable Computing 19:127–141, Theorem 5.1：https://interval.louisiana.edu/reliable-computing-journal/volume-19/reliable-computing-19-pp-127-141.pdf 。该单调矩阵方法属于已有理论；本文的网格表达式与应用实验不能冒称新发明的通用定理。

## 5. 数学上界与浮点认证的区别

上述证明针对精确离散矩阵、精确残差以及精确屏障。ordinary NumPy/SciPy 的浮点残差可能由于消去而偏小，矩阵系数与屏障也有舍入。为了把程序返回的数称为“认证上界”，至少需要：

- 明确被认证的是精确数学离散矩阵，还是已经舍入并存储的矩阵。
- 通过有向舍入、区间算术或可证明的保守舍入包络得到真实残差的上界 c_bar。
- 确保计算的 max z 不小于精确 max z，或者对实际采用的屏障逐项验证 A z≥1。
- 缓存方法中的 δ 同样必须可靠上包络，δ≥1 时应拒绝证书或重新验证。

本 oracle 用 Fraction 对 n=1、2、7、24 的若干有理参数组合逐项检查 Az−1≥0，检查本身在这些组合上是精确的；一般参数结论来自上述代数证明。它没有把普通浮点残差评估伪装成已认证实现。当前数值测试只说明样本上界覆盖误差。

## 6. 独立验证的预期

- 一维常源问题嵌入二维条带，上下绝热、左右正 Robin：连续 T(x)=−qx²/(2k)+ax+b，其中 a=q(1+h_R/(2k))/(k+h_R+h_R k/h_L)、b=ka/h_L。此 FVM 的精确离散中心值为 T(x_i)+qΔ²/(8k)。这给出独立于矩阵重复计算的强校验；该绝热变体仅是验证用例，不是题面的测试参数。
- 光滑二维制造解 T=[1+c x(1−x)][1+c y(1−y)]，所有 h=ck，源项 q=2kc[1+c x(1−x)+1+c y(1−y)]。对源积分精确计算后，用 n=8、16、32、64 比较连续中心值；本次观测的无穷范数误差阶约为 1.980、1.979、1.989。这个结果支持该制造案例的收敛，不是任意不连续源的误差阶证明。
- 小残差大误差的代数例子 A=diag(10⁻⁹,1)、T=(1,0)、T̃=0，残差无穷范数 10⁻⁹ 而场误差为 1。它是 SPD 反例，不应冒称为本热 PDE 的物理反例。

独立脚本目前 8 类检查全部通过；详细数值以 oracle_results.json 为准。

# A sign-separated spatial residual certificate

Status: local finding with an executed exact-arithmetic checker; intermediate verification requested separately. No novelty or timing improvement is claimed.

## Model and assumptions

Let n be a positive integer, N=n^2, and Delta=1/n. Number cells in row-major order. The four boundary parameters h=(h_left,h_right,h_top,h_bottom) lie independently in [1/5,5]. For each face-neighbor pair the matrix entry is -1. Each diagonal equals the number of face neighbors plus beta_s=Delta/(1/h_s+Delta/2) for each incident boundary face. In particular, the single cell when n=1 has four boundary faces and no neighbors. Assume, as supplied, that every A_h is invertible with entrywise nonnegative inverse. Let A_0 denote the matrix with all four parameters equal to 1/5. Since beta_s increases with h_s, D=A_h-A_0 is a nonnegative diagonal matrix.

For an arbitrary real residual vector r, the discrete error satisfies A_h e=r exactly. The certificate concerns this discrete algebraic error, not continuum discretization error. A floating-point residual used in place of r requires a separate enclosure of its uncertainty.

Fix a partition B_1,...,B_K of the N cells into nonempty disjoint blocks before online evaluation. Write b_k for the indicator vector of B_k. Precompute offline

    w_k = A_0^{-1} b_k,    z = sum_k w_k = A_0^{-1} 1.

These are full cellwise response vectors. Define r_i^+=max(r_i,0), r_i^-=max(-r_i,0), and

    a_k^+ = max_{j in B_k} r_j^+,
    a_k^- = max_{j in B_k} r_j^-,
    c_k = max_{j in B_k} |r_j| = max(a_k^+,a_k^-),
    p = sum_k a_k^+ w_k,
    q = sum_k a_k^- w_k,
    t = sum_k c_k w_k.

The zero residual is included: all coefficients and bounds then vanish.

## Certificate and proof

For every allowed h and every r, componentwise

    -q <= e <= p.

Consequently, with the infinity norm denoting the maximum absolute entry,

    ||e||_infinity <= C(r) := max(||p||_infinity, ||q||_infinity)
                  <= U(r) := ||t||_infinity
                  <= B(r) := ||r||_infinity ||z||_infinity.

Here B is precisely the supplied uniform residual-norm baseline.

Proof. The resolvent identity gives

    A_0^{-1} - A_h^{-1} = A_0^{-1} D A_h^{-1} >= 0

entrywise, because each factor on the right is nonnegative. Therefore 0 <= A_h^{-1} <= A_0^{-1}. Define the nonnegative block envelopes g^+=sum_k a_k^+ b_k and g^-=sum_k a_k^- b_k. By construction 0 <= r^+ <= g^+ and 0 <= r^- <= g^-. Thus

    0 <= u := A_h^{-1} r^+ <= A_0^{-1} g^+ = p,
    0 <= v := A_h^{-1} r^- <= A_0^{-1} g^- = q.

Since e=u-v, it follows that -q <= e <= p. Hence |e_i| <= max(p_i,q_i) and the asserted norm certificate follows. Every w_k is nonnegative, a_k^+ <= c_k and a_k^- <= c_k, so p <= t and q <= t. Finally c_k <= ||r||_infinity and the indicators partition the grid, giving t <= ||r||_infinity z. Taking maxima proves both comparisons. This argument covers the entire continuous parameter box and every positive integer n; finite tests are not used to infer that coverage.

## Position, sign, and cancellation

The responses w_k encode block position, while the two coefficient sets preserve positive and negative residual envelopes separately. Moving a residual within one block without changing its extrema cannot change C. Symmetry can also make different blocks have the same scalar bound. The method therefore resolves location only at the chosen block scale and need not distinguish every pair of source locations.

The estimate uses |u_i-v_i| <= max(u_i,v_i), followed by separate upper bounds. It does not infer |u_i-v_i| <= |p_i-q_i|. The latter implication is false for upper bounds alone: u=1, v=0 and p=q=1 satisfy the upper-bound conditions but would give a false zero estimate. In the executed 4-by-4 checkerboard case, p=q=z for the coarse partition, yet e is nonzero, giving a counterexample to this subtraction rule within the supplied model itself.

If both residual signs are present, the connected-grid irreducible M-matrix has a strictly positive inverse, so both propagated parts are positive at every cell and actual cancellation occurs there. Nevertheless, sign presence and separate upper envelopes do not certify a particular positive amount of cancellation to subtract: no lower bound on either propagated part was computed. A negative part can be arbitrarily small while still having negative entries. The identity |u_i-v_i|=u_i+v_i-2 min(u_i,v_i) shows exactly what additional information would be needed. Certified lower bounds on u and v, or certified responses for the actual parameter and residual, can justify stronger cancellation estimates; subtracting upper bounds cannot. No such stronger estimate is claimed or implemented here.

## Strict gain with an explicit calculation

Take n=2, all h_s=1/5, singleton blocks, and r=(1,1,-1,-1), with the positive cells in the top row. Here beta=2/21 and A_0=L+(4/21)I, where L is the four-cell face-neighbor graph Laplacian. We have L1=0 and Lr=2r. Therefore

    z=(21/4)1,    e=(21/46)r.

Since r^+=(1+r)/2 and r^-=(1-r)/2,

    p=(z+e)/2,    q=(z-e)/2.

It follows that

    actual error = 21/46 = 0.45652173913043476,
    C = (21/4+21/46)/2 = 525/184 = 2.8532608695652173,
    U = B = 21/4 = 5.25,
    C/B = 25/46 = 0.5434782608695652 < 1.

Thus sign separation strictly improves even on the unsigned spatial envelope in this example. C is valid for this same residual throughout the allowed parameter box; the displayed actual error is specifically at h_min.

## Equality and coarse-block limitations

For any grid and partition, let r=c1 with c any real constant. Then C=B=|c| ||z||_infinity. At h=h_min, e=cz, so actual error=C=B. This is an attained equality case, not merely an asymptotic limit. For fixed nonzero c, actual error approaches this equality as h approaches h_min by continuity of the matrix inverse. For n=1 and c=1 at h_min, the common value is 11/8.

For n=4, partition into the four 2-by-2 quadrants and take r_{x,y}=(-1)^(x+y). Every block contains both +1 and -1, hence a_k^+=a_k^-=c_k=1 and p=q=t=z. The certificate equals the baseline, 3569/168 = 21.24404761904762. The executed reference solve at h_min gives actual error 2583/7304 = 0.3536418400876232. Thus block extrema can discard substantial cancellation information, and mixed signs alone do not force a strict gain in this estimator.

## Constructive execution evidence

The self-contained standard-library script is experiments/moonshine_bound.py relative to this workspace. It was actually executed through run_python_script using the project-relative path workspace/experiments/moonshine_bound.py. The tool returned status ok, returncode 0, empty stderr, and JSON results.

All matrices, solves, envelopes, and assertions use fractions.Fraction. Displayed decimals are conversions only; the assertion tolerance is zero. Grid sizes are n=1,2,3,4. Blocks are formed by splitting each coordinate at ceil(n/2), omitting empty blocks. The test set uses all 81 independent parameter combinations in {1/5,1,5}^4 and eight named residual vectors on each grid: zero, constant positive, constant negative, row sign split, checkerboard, corner spike, center spike, and a fixed modular mixed pattern. Some named vectors coincide on the smallest grids, so counts describe tested cases, not necessarily distinct vectors.

Observed output:

- 2,592 tested parameter/residual cases; 648 per grid.
- 1,053 cases with C < B.
- All componentwise and norm coverage assertions passed.
- All C <= U <= B assertions passed.
- Offline response equations and all reference equations passed exactly.
- Partition coverage and the four-face n=1 assembly check passed.
- Strict-gain and equality examples passed their exact fraction assertions.
- Minimum C minus actual error was 0; maximum C/B over nonzero residuals was 1.
- Four offline solve batches and 324 reference solve batches; online_bound contains no solve.

For the n=4 corner and center spikes at h_min, C=6.212967574205299 and B=21.24404761904762 in both cases; actual errors were respectively 1.8898066970856064 and 1.657769009685773. The identical candidate values illustrate the coarse symmetric partition's limited spatial resolution.

## Offline/online separation and numerical limitations

The function offline_precompute solves A_0 W=H for the fixed block indicators and verifies this identity exactly. The function online_bound only computes residual block maxima, weighted sums of stored responses, and maxima over cells. It performs no matrix assembly, factorization, or direct solve. Direct solutions of A_h E=R in main are reference checks only. Solve-count JSON fields describe this code structure, rather than independent runtime instrumentation.

The proof assumes exact responses and an exact residual. This checker meets that assumption for its rational data. Ordinary floating-point precomputation alone is not a rigorous outward certificate: an implementation would need verified response enclosures and outward arithmetic. Certified nonnegative supersolutions Wbar_k satisfying A_0 Wbar_k >= b_k would give a valid upper certificate, but their inflation need not preserve comparison with the exact baseline; that comparison requires separate accounting. If the true residual differs from a computed residual by at most epsilon componentwise, a valid additional uncertainty allowance is epsilon ||z||_infinity, by the same inverse comparison and the triangle inequality.

The checks establish reproducible finite examples, while the algebra establishes continuous-parameter validity. No continuum error bound, novelty result, or timing improvement is asserted. The supplied task file was not edited.

# Two-sided residual interval: independent check of the team-supplied strengthening

Status: derived and tested with exact rational arithmetic; one intermediate verification is requested separately. The proposed interval was explicitly supplied by the external project team. No autonomous discovery, novelty, or timing improvement is claimed.

## Prior evidence and preserved files

The existing workspace/residual_proof.md and workspace/experiments/moonshine_bound.py are preserved. The first-round execution reported 2592 cases and, for n=2 with singleton blocks and r=(1,1,-1,-1), actual error 21/46, sign-separated bound 525/184, and uniform baseline 21/4 at the weak endpoint. Retrieved session evidence includes the successful three-dimensional intermediate review moonshine-a44344345b584ef4afcd95f256463173. An earlier research-log summary preceded that successful review.

## Model and envelopes

Let n>=1 be an integer, N=n^2, Delta=1/n, and h=(h_left,h_right,h_top,h_bottom) belong to [1/5,5]^4. Number cells in row-major order. A_h has off-diagonal -1 for face neighbors and zero for other distinct cells. Each diagonal is its face-neighbor count plus beta_s=Delta/(1/h_s+Delta/2) for each incident boundary face. All four faces are counted when n=1. Assume every A_h is invertible with entrywise nonnegative inverse, as supplied. Increasing h adds a nonnegative diagonal. Write A_W=A_(1/5,1/5,1/5,1/5), A_S=A_(5,5,5,5), G_h=A_h^{-1}, GW=A_W^{-1}, and GS=A_S^{-1}. The exact discrete error is e=G_h r for any real residual vector r.

Fix a partition into nonempty disjoint blocks B_k covering all cells. Define r_pos=max(r,0) and r_neg=max(-r,0) componentwise. Canonical blockwise envelopes take the minimum and maximum of each part over each block: l_pos, u_pos, l_neg, u_neg. Zeros must be included in those extrema. The required conditions are

    0 <= l_pos <= r_pos <= u_pos,
    0 <= l_neg <= r_neg <= u_neg.

The interval proof also applies to arbitrary envelopes satisfying these conditions, without requiring exact block extrema. Nonnegativity of the lower envelopes matters: if supplied lower bounds are negative, replace them componentwise by their maximum with zero before using GS. The comparison with the canonical unsigned spatial bound below uses the canonical upper block maxima, not arbitrarily inflated upper envelopes.

## Interval and scalar certificate

Set p=GW u_pos, q=GW u_neg, a=GS l_pos, and b=GS l_neg. The team-supplied interval is

    L=a-q,    U=p-b.

Then, for every admissible h,

    L <= e <= U,
    ||e||_infinity <= C_interval := max_i max(-L_i,U_i)
                    = max(||L||_infinity,||U||_infinity)
                    <= C_one := max_i max(p_i,q_i).

For canonical upper envelopes, put c_k=max_{j in B_k}|r_j|, t=GW sum_k c_k 1_Bk, and z=GW 1. The complete comparison is

    ||e||_infinity <= C_interval <= C_one <= ||t||_infinity
                    <= ||r||_infinity ||z||_infinity.

C_one is the first-round sign-separated certificate, formed from upper bounds on the two nonnegative propagated parts. The unsigned spatial block maximum certificate is ||t||_infinity. Both comparisons are included to distinguish these meanings of a one-sided block bound.

Proof. The identities

    GW-G_h = GW (A_h-A_W) G_h >= 0,
    G_h-GS = G_h (A_S-A_h) GS >= 0

prove 0<=GS<=G_h<=GW entrywise. Both parameter endpoints are used. For each sign, positivity and envelope domination imply GS l_sign <= G_h r_sign <= GW u_sign. Subtracting the negative interval from the positive interval gives L<=e<=U. In particular, 0<=a<=p, 0<=b<=q, and -q<=L<=U<=p. For any real interval [L_i,U_i], the largest absolute value is max(-L_i,U_i); because L_i<=U_i, this also equals max(|L_i|,|U_i|). Taking the maximum over cells proves the scalar formula. Since U_i=p_i-b_i<=p_i and -L_i=q_i-a_i<=q_i, C_interval<=C_one. Finally the canonical positive and negative block maxima are each at most c_k, which is at most ||r||_infinity. Positivity of GW gives p,q<=t<=||r||_infinity z. This proves the entire chain over the continuous parameter box, independently of finite tests.

## Strictness and its limits

Let C=C_one. Since every p_i,q_i is at most C and a_i,b_i are nonnegative, the exact equality criterion is

    C_interval=C if and only if there exists i with
    (p_i=C and b_i=0) or (q_i=C and a_i=0).

Indeed, the finite maximum of p_i-b_i and q_i-a_i equals C exactly when one of these terms equals C; a nonnegative subtraction can attain C only under the displayed conditions. This includes r=0. Interval shrinkage alone therefore does not imply a smaller scalar certificate.

For canonical extrema, a same-sign residual gives C_interval=C_one: when r>=0, q=b=0 and U=p; when r<=0, p=a=0 and -L=q. Lower information can narrow the other interval endpoint but cannot lower the maximum absolute endpoint. This says nothing against an improvement of C_one over the uniform baseline due to spatial localization. If both lower envelopes vanish, the entire interval equals the old interval [-q,p]. A block containing both signs has both canonical lower coefficients zero; so does a block containing a zero when considering either part.

On the connected grid GS is strictly positive. To see this, a column x=GS e_j is nonnegative. If x_i=0, the equation at i contradicts its positive right-hand side when i=j; otherwise its nonpositive neighbor sum must be zero, forcing all neighbors to zero. Connectedness propagates to j and gives a contradiction. Thus any nonzero nonnegative lower envelope has a strictly positive propagated response at every cell. If both l_pos and l_neg are nonzero, both a and b are strictly positive, so C_interval<C_one. With only one nonzero lower envelope the exact equality criterion determines whether the unchanged side still attains the old maximum. Mixed signs alone are insufficient.

For u=G_h r_pos and v=G_h r_neg, actual cancellation satisfies u_i+v_i-|u_i-v_i|=2 min(u_i,v_i)>=2 min(a_i,b_i). This is a justified quantitative cancellation allowance when both lower responses are positive. The interval uses lower information on the opposing sign; it never subtracts two upper bounds. Its endpoints may be conservative because upper and lower responses use different parameter endpoints and need not be simultaneously attained.

## Executed exact examples

The new independent standard-library script workspace/experiments/moonshine_interval.py was written and actually executed using run_python_script(path='workspace/experiments/moonshine_interval.py', timeout_seconds=60). Tool call moonshine-7b35ed8dc5084ba0974a2164ca9222bd returned status ok, returncode 0, empty stderr, and JSON stdout. The script also saves workspace/experiments/moonshine_interval.json. All assertions use fractions.Fraction with zero tolerance; decimals are display only.

For n=2, singleton blocks, r=(1,1,-1,-1), write H for the four-cell graph Laplacian. At the weak endpoint A_W=H+(4/21)I, and at the strong endpoint A_S=H+(20/9)I. Since H1=0 and Hr=2r, GW1=(21/4)1, GWr=(21/46)r, GS1=(9/20)1, and GSr=(9/38)r. Therefore p has entries 525/184 in the positive row and 441/184 in the negative row, while b has entries 81/760 and 261/760 respectively. Consequently

    C_interval=525/184-81/760=12003/4370=2.7466819221967964,
    C_one=525/184=2.8532608695652173,
    unsigned spatial bound=uniform baseline=21/4.

The exact interval vectors are L=(-8973,-8973,-12003,-12003)/4370 and U=(12003,12003,8973,8973)/4370. At h=(1/5,1/5,1/5,1/5), actual error=21/46. At the asymmetric strict interior point h=(1/2,1,2,3), the exact error vector is (114777/316801,110495/316801,-95718/316801,-278180/950403), with norm 114777/316801=0.3622999927399219. The same certificates cover both cases.

For n=2, r=(1,1,1,1), and weak h, L=(9/20)1, U=(21/4)1, and actual=C_interval=C_one=21/4. No bound valid at this attained equality case can be strictly smaller than the actual error. For n=2, a single block containing all cells, r=(1,-1,-1,1), and weak h, both lower envelopes vanish. Actual error is 21/88, while C_interval=C_one=baseline=21/4.

## Counterexample to applying GW directly to a signed residual

Let n=2, x=(1,-1,1,-1), r=A_W x=(46/21)x, and h=(1/5,5,1/5,1/5). Then GW r=x has norm 1. The actual error is e=(437,-69,437,-69)/269, with norm 437/269=1.6245353159851301>1. Row symmetry reduces its equations to

    (25/21)e_left-e_right=46/21,
    -e_left+(139/63)e_right=-46/21.

The displayed solution satisfies both equations exactly. Thus both |G_h r|<=|GW r| componentwise and ||G_h r||_infinity<=||GW r||_infinity are false. Inverse entrywise ordering cannot be applied directly to signed input. The valid interval still covers this example: its bound is 4001/665, the one-sided bound is 25/4, and the uniform baseline is 23/2. This counterexample refutes the unsafe shortcut, not the team-supplied interval.

## Test scope and implementation limits

The test set uses n=1,2 and 82 parameter tuples per grid: all 81 combinations in {1/5,1,5}^4 plus (1/2,1,2,3). At n=1 the single partition and residuals 0,1,-1 give 246 cases. At n=2, three partitions (singletons, two rows, and the whole grid) and seven residuals (zero, constant positive, constant negative, row split, checkerboard, corner spike, and (2,-1,0,-3)) give 1722 cases. Total: 1968. All coverage, comparison, reference-equation, inverse-ordering, partition, equality-criterion, and n=1 four-face checks passed. There were 328 strict interval improvements: 82 parameter tuples times three qualifying singleton residuals (row split, checkerboard, irregular) and one qualifying two-row residual (row split). The constructed signed-GW counterexample was an additional check outside that count.

Offline, store GW 1_Bk and GS 1_Bk for each block. Online, compute block extrema, linear combinations of stored responses, and maxima. The script's online() contains no assembly or solve. Its printed zero online solve count describes code structure, not independent runtime instrumentation. Exact residuals and responses are assumed. Floating-point deployment needs certified response and residual enclosures and outward arithmetic, using lower response enclosures for subtracted lower contributions and upper response enclosures for upper contributions. For residual uncertainty ||r-r_computed||_infinity<=epsilon, one safe extra scalar allowance is epsilon||GW1||_infinity. This concerns discrete algebraic error only, not continuum discretization error. The finite tests corroborate the proof and do not establish continuous-parameter coverage by sampling.

The task file and first-round artifacts were not changed. The intermediate review outcome will be archived separately in workspace/residual_interval_verification.md, including any inconclusive result.

four_cell.proof_text:
# 四格散热算例：残差的位置、符号与最大误差

本文是固定离散系统的局部推导，供后续 LaTeX 报告引用。当前文件写入时尚未执行程序或完成独立审核；执行证据以 workspace/mode_results.json 及原生工具返回为准，审核状态以后续审核归档为准。

## 1. 假设、编号与可逆性

单位正方形采用 2×2 有限体积网格，下排从左到右为 1、2，上排从左到右为 3、4。四条边的 Robin 系数固定为 h=1/5。本推导以题目直接给出的矩阵为依据，不额外推断从 Robin 条件到矩阵系数的离散过程。令边集 E={(1,2),(1,3),(2,4),(3,4)}，无权图拉普拉斯为 L，A=L+(4/21)I，误差与残差满足 Ae=r，r 属于实四维空间。每个顶点度数为 2，故 A 对角元为 46/21，相邻顶点间的元素为 -1，其余元素为 0。无穷范数定义为各分量绝对值的最大值。

任意非零实向量 x 满足 $x^T A x=Σ_{(i,j)∈E}(x_i-x_j)^2+(4/21)Σ_i x_i^2>0$，所以 A 对称正定，方程解唯一。

## 2. 三个模式的精确误差

记常量模式 $u=(1,1,1,1)^T$，横条纹模式 $s=(1,1,-1,-1)^T$，棋盘格模式 $q=(1,-1,-1,1)^T$。拉普拉斯的分量公式为 $(Lv)_i=Σ_{j∼i}(v_i-v_j)$。

常量模式中，每条边两端相等，因此 Lu=0。横条纹模式中，每个顶点的一名邻居同号，另一名邻居异号，所以 Ls=2s。棋盘格模式中，每个顶点的两名邻居均异号，所以 Lq=4q。这些计算直接使用了正负号的空间位置。

于是 $Au=(4/21)u$、$As=(46/21)s$、$Aq=(88/21)q$。通过唯一性，残差分别取 u、s、q 时，解分别为 $e_u=(21/4)u$、$e_s=(21/46)s$、$e_q=(21/88)q$。因为三个残差的无穷范数都为 1，对应精确误差范数分别是 $21/4$、$21/46$、$21/88$。这些数值来自代数推导，程序执行前不作为实验结果陈述。

## 3. 统一基线的有效性与信息损失

先证明 A 的逆逐项非负。若 Ax=b 且 b 逐项非负，假设 x 的最小分量 x_k<0，则每个邻居满足 x_j≥x_k，因此 $(Ax)_k=Σ_{j∼k}(x_k-x_j)+(4/21)x_k<0$，与 b_k≥0 矛盾。所以 x≥0。将 b 依次取坐标单位向量，就得到 A⁻¹ 逐项非负。

由 $Au=(4/21)u$ 得到 $A^{-1}u=(21/4)u$。逐分量三角不等式与非负性给出 $|A^{-1}r|≤A^{-1}|r|≤(21/4)‖r‖∞u$，从而统一基线为 $B(r)=‖A^{-1}u‖∞‖r‖∞=(21/4)‖r‖∞$。对本题三个残差，基线均为 21/4，无法区分。对所有实残差而言，这个仅使用残差无穷范数的常数不能改小，因为常量模式已经取等。

横条纹的基线与真实误差之比为 $(21/4)/(21/46)=23/2$，棋盘格为 $(21/4)/(21/88)=22$。即使使用逐位置幅值界 $‖A^{-1}|r|‖∞$，本题也仍得到相同的 21/4，因为三者逐位置绝对值均为 1。要区分它们，必须保留符号与位置的对应关系。

## 4. 利用有符号空间结构的界及取等范围

补充另一方向条纹 $t=(1,-1,1,-1)^T$，同样有 Lt=2t。四个向量 u、s、t、q 两两正交，平方长度均为 4，因此构成实四维空间的完整基。任意实残差唯一分解为 $r=a u+b s+c t+d q$，其中 $a=(r_1+r_2+r_3+r_4)/4$，$b=(r_1+r_2-r_3-r_4)/4$，$c=(r_1-r_2+r_3-r_4)/4$，$d=(r_1-r_2-r_3+r_4)/4$。这些系数使用了残差的幅值、符号与格号位置。

对本题固定矩阵，完整解公式为 $e=αu+βs+γt+δq$，其中 $α=21a/4$、$β=21b/46$、$γ=21c/46$、$δ=21d/88$。故精确表达式为 $‖e‖∞=max{|α+β+γ+δ|,|α+β-γ-δ|,|α-β+γ-δ|,|α-β-γ+δ|}$。这是完整解公式，不把它误称为无需解算信息的普适估计。

另由三角不等式得到真正的模态上界 $‖e‖∞≤M(r)=(21/4)|a|+(21/46)(|b|+|c|)+(21/88)|d|$。它对该固定矩阵下的任意实残差成立，计算只需四个有符号投影，不必逐次消元。结合原有基线，可使用 $‖e‖∞≤min{B(r),M(r)}$，避免声称 M 对任意混合残差都优于基线。

取等条件也可精确陈述：M 取等，当且仅当存在某个格号 i，使得 αu_i、βs_i、γt_i、δq_i 中所有非零项具有同一符号；零向量亦取等。这是对应坐标上三角不等式取等的充要条件。三个指定残差各自只有一个非零模态系数，因此 M 分别为 21/4、21/46、21/88，全部等于真实误差，达到逐例最紧上界。每个模态权重也都不能单独减小并仍对所有残差有效，因为取对应纯模式即可检验。对混合模式，三角不等式仍可能丢失抵消，故 M 不保证普遍取等；需要精确值时应使用上面的四分量最大值公式。

## 5. 为什么正负数量不够

横条纹 s 和棋盘格 q 均有两个 +1、两个 -1，残差无穷范数均为 1，且分量和均为零。然而 $‖e_s‖∞/‖e_q‖∞=(21/46)/(21/88)=44/23$，二者不同。横条纹每个顶点只有一条异号相邻边，棋盘格每个顶点有两条；因此它们激发不同特征值，后者受到更强的离散扩散抑制。正负数量相同，乃至平均残差同为零，都不足以唯一确定最大误差。这里的比较固定了幅值与矩阵，差别来自空间排列。

## 6. 适用范围与推广所需条件

本轮严格证明对象是题设固定四格矩阵及其离散误差 Ae=r；未证明连续温度场的误差界，也未包含建模误差或网格离散误差的额外估计。h=1/5 是题面背景，实际代数证明依赖给定的 A；不能将 4/21 不经重新离散就替换成一般 h 的函数。

任意残差推广不能仅凭三个模式外推。本文已经补上第四个模式、证明完备性，并给出完整分解，因此在同一固定矩阵内对任意实残差的公式与上界有独立代数依据；程序对坐标基的精确检查提供补充证据，而不是用有限数值样本代替一般证明。若只有正负数量而不知道每格的幅值和位置，则这些模态系数并未确定，不能据此使用对应纯模式的误差常数。

若改变边界条件、Robin 系数、网格或离散约定，应先构造新的矩阵，再检查可逆性或零空间及相容条件，检查所需的逆矩阵非负性，重新求解比较向量 A⁻¹u，并建立新的模态分解或 Green 函数论证。原有对称性及上述四个特征模式不保证保留；若逆矩阵非负性不成立，则以 ‖A⁻¹u‖∞ 为系数的统一界也不能直接沿用，一般需要诱导范数 ‖A⁻¹‖∞。本文不声称已完成这些变化边界的推广。

## 7. 可复核程序与证据路径

程序 workspace/experiments/mode_check.py 仅使用 Python 标准库，从边集重新组装 A，以 Fraction 高斯—若尔当消元独立求解，再进行逐分量精确回代、模态公式比对、逆矩阵非负性及行和检查。程序还在完整坐标基上检查模态逆公式与消元结果一致。断言全部成功后，标准输出打印简洁 JSON，并将精确残差、解、误差范数、基线、模态界、检查标志以及脚本和本文的 SHA-256 保存到 workspace/mode_results.json。

本文件不预写运行成功或审核通过的状态。运行结果必须由 run_python_script 实际产生；独立局部审核须使用 verify_overall(scope=intermediate, review_count=1)，并同时检查假设、计算、逻辑三个维度。后续报告应引用实际运行归档与审核证据，不能将问题质量评估通过等同于证明审核通过。
